status: restart collision mechanism fixed; cold path waiting and broader file/call reliability remain open

controlled_defects.defect: New hub reset its stream ID counter while the remote application retained a live stream. A fresh SYN reused that route without a fresh accept.
controlled_defects.proof: Both node-order/parity cases fail on parent production source and pass after correction, using the real async mux and driver, a healthy in-memory network, a blackholed old source generation and a still-open remote application stream. Fresh request/reply bytes reach only the fresh accepted stream.
controlled_defects.correction: One process-wide allocator survives hub recreation; OS randomness seeds its starting point for a new process. Existing direction parity and wire format remain unchanged.

controlled_defects.defect: After 64 occupied probes, open replaced a live local stream route.
controlled_defects.proof: A fixture retaining 65 channels across counter wrap fails on parent source and passes after correction. Every retained channel remains the route owner.
controlled_defects.correction: Only a vacant route entry may be installed; occupied entries are skipped.

controlled_defects.defect: An unrelated or malformed SYN_ACK established an opening stream despite not acknowledging its SYN.
controlled_defects.proof: The parent enters Established on the invalid answer. Correction checks older/future ACK values at normal and wrapping initial sequences, retaining the pending handshake and recovery timer until an exact ACK arrives.
controlled_defects.correction: The opening SYN_ACK must acknowledge exactly the initial SYN byte.

limits: Stream ID namespace remains finite (31 counter bits plus parity). A random process seed avoids deterministic restart reuse but cannot guarantee that a random ID never collides with a retained remote route.
The controlled test restarts a hub within a process. A cross-process remote-state collision probability is reduced by OS-random seeding, not eliminated or exhaustively tested.
Physical file observations do not replay the exact controlled source-restart schedule or isolate the effect of the allocator from WAN variation.
Only one new reverse 32-MiB run passed. Long-transfer stability, cold startup, call media, Windows reports and the full multi-device matrix remain unqualified.

remaining_cold_wait.description: One initial retained cell and growing local WouldBlock retries, before network handshake RTO. This is an observed local path availability wait, not a measured network RTT. Its cause remains under investigation.

privacy: Public evidence is limited to aggregate values: no endpoint identifiers, addresses, paths, keys, packet sequences, raw captures or file hashes.
